method: GEOS whole-geometry disjointness against a closed envelope containing every complete source coordinate, complete selected coordinate, and all requested native centres; no clipping, repair, simplification, positive substitution or coverage removal. All admitted negative operands are byte-equivalent JSON whole geometries.
limits: Envelope proof applies only to the authenticated original source/selected geometry and full requested mask; any changed source or mask requires a new proof.
Compaction cannot certify sovereignty, source role, current land status, or clear pre-existing source-fitness holds.
